changes: PipeWire filter that denoises the built-in camera of Apple silicon laptops, with its video-encoder and Neural Engine backends; the user service is enabled for every user, as alarm-aurora's user preset does.
notes: Backends live in /usr/lib/<triplet>/aurora-camera-denoise (Debian's libdir); alarm-aurora uses /usr/lib/aurora-camera-denoise. The daemon has the directory built in.
